hits.description: Cozy 2-bedroom apartment in the heart of the Eixample neighborhood. This welcoming apartment is fully furnished and equipped, making it ideal for students and interns looking for temporary accommodation in Barcelona. The apartment is located on the fourth floor of a building without an elevator and features two bedrooms: one double bedroom with a double bed and one single bedroom with a single bed and access to a small outdoor balcony. It has a comfortable living and dining area equipped with a sofa, television, and dining table, perfect for relaxing after a day of studying or working. The kitchen is separate and fully equipped with a ceramic hob, microwave, refrigerator, kitchen utensils, and storage space. The apartment also features a complete bathroom with a shower.

Alojamiento solo chicas. Excellence stay con mucha luz natural, galería y conjunto de descanso. Está equipada con cama doble, mesitas de noche, cómoda, armario de grandes dimensiones, escritorio con silla y sillón de relajación con lámpara. Está ubicada cerca de un gran baño completo y de un pequeño comedor. Dispone de estantes con elementos decorativos de diseño, un reloj de pared y bonitas plantas que hacen de la estancia un espacio armónico y lleno de vida. Es un espacio donde encontrarás todo lo necesario para hospedarte en un entorno confortable con todo tipo de detalle. Tiene un tamaño de 15m2.
